candidate_relations.reason: The clinical record describes findings consistent with Posterior Urethral Valves (bilateral renal enlargement, hydronephrosis, markedly dilated fetal bladder, oligohydramnios, elevated serum creatinine, bladder wall irregularity, bilateral ureteral dilation, urinary retention). However, Wunderlich syndrome specifically refers to spontaneous non-traumatic renal hemorrhage into the subcapsular and/or perirenal spaces. While the perirenal fluid collection could be a complication or manifestation of the underlying urinary tract obstruction, Posterior Urethral Valves is a distinct diagnostic entity and a potential cause of the overall presentation, not Wunderlich syndrome itself.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Posterior Urethral Valves is a cause of the observed findings, not the Wunderlich syndrome itself.
